entries.title: Crusader Kings
entries.definitive_edition: Crusader Kings Complete on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the current Windows PC storefront release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2004 grand-strategy game.

primary.why: The Windows PC route is the most accessible current way to play the original game with the Deus Vult expansion included through Crusader Kings Complete. The Mac release is historically valid, but Windows PC has the clearest current storefront and compatibility documentation.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Crusader Kings Complete on Steam or GOG for Windows PC; that package includes the base game and Crusader Kings: Deus Vult.

entries.remaster_caveats: Deus Vult is an expansion bundled into the Complete package, not a separate mainline entry. Crusader Kings II and III are separate sequels.

entries.title: Crusader Kings II
entries.definitive_edition: Crusader Kings II on Windows PC with the desired DLC library

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.version: Free base game with DLC library available
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original release route, has the full DLC library, mod support, and the best capture/settings compatibility. macOS and Linux are valid native routes, but Windows PC is the safest complete recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Install the free Crusader Kings II base game on Steam for Windows PC, then add the DLC packs you want; the full legacy content path is a DLC library rather than separate game entries.

entries.remaster_caveats: Crusader Kings II's expansions and content packs are DLC, not separate game entries. The base game became free-to-play while DLC remains separately managed.

entries.title: Crusader Kings III
entries.definitive_edition: Crusader Kings III on Windows PC with current DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native high-end PC presentation with mod/DLC support.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC library
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the highest-fidelity and most complete route, with the earliest/broadest DLC access, mod support, keyboard-and-mouse controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are strong controller-focused ports, but they do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, the Paradox store, or Xbox PC/Game Pass. Add current DLC through the PC storefront if you want the complete content path.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions are console adaptations, not remasters or separate entries. CK3's chapter packs and expansions are DLC, not separate games.
